- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.

Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.
context: Gale is a companion wizard traveling with the player who reveals, in a serious tone, that he suffers from a dangerous condition that periodically forces him to consume raw magic from powerful artifacts. He once relied on a cache of items in his Waterdeep tower that is now gone, so he’s asking the player to help locate replacements — a request that could involve danger or moral cost. One dialogue option lets the player use the shared tadpole to probe Gale’s mind (a brief, cinematic “mind‑meld”) and confirm the threat; Gale reacts as if that is a grave violation and may threaten to leave, though he can be mollified if convinced of the necessity. This conversation appears during exploration/camp talk and precedes later night/camp scenes (Night 3/4) and some branches require higher approval to unlock.
